audit.why: 49.88% over 1692 games with TRICKY 7.5/10 and an 8/10 carry threat is consistent; the mirror made no difficulty change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven chart rows were wrong in BOTH layers at once, so the layers agreed with each other while disagreeing with the data and with their own why text.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill]. whys[0] describes a neutral level 1, whys[1] and whys[2] describe Riven's level 2-3 burst winning, whys[3] says neither side has an edge, whys[5] calls her first item her strongest solo-kill window, whys[6] describes a map-decided game. The mirror (riven__shen) has already been set to exactly this chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 6 to Skill; rows 1, 2 and 5 to Riven — both layers, one atomic group, all six ratings re-pointed. phases[0].why and phases[6].why rewritten so the prose stops contradicting its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: the page never names Riven's abilities except Ki Burst, and it never states that Ki Burst cancels Stand United.
audit.why: Broken Wings (Q, 13s, three activations, third knocks back), Ki Burst (W, 11/10/9/8/7s stun) and Blade of the Exile (R) are the real names. Stand United is a channel, so her 260-range stun cancels it and burns 200/180/160 seconds.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings named in whys[1], spikes[0] and spikes[2]; the Ki Burst-cancels-your-R warning added to whys[4].

audit.why: whys[5] and wants.foe[1] already give Ki Burst's 11-second rank-1 cooldown and key the trade to baiting it.
audit.corrected: Left alone — this is the one part of the page that already met the bar.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has a real combo yet — hold the blade close, farm at Q range, and learn how she contests the first waves.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in you can eat her full combo, but her 8/10 carry threat is real — close this on the map, not in a sidelane duel.

edits.before: She reaches full Q-W-Q burst at level 2-3 and can chain dashes into your Ki Barrier before it regenerates — hold E to taunt her mid-combo rather than spending it as an opener.
edits.after: She reaches full Broken Wings into Ki Burst at 2-3 and chains dashes through Ki Barrier before it regenerates — hold E to taunt her mid-combo, never as an opener.

edits.before: Stand United coming online at level 6 is the turning point — she cannot punish a Shen who stops fighting her and starts roaming globally with R.
edits.after: Stand United at 6 is the turning point — she cannot punish a Shen who stops fighting her, but never channel it inside Ki Burst range.

edits.before: Riven gets all three Q dashes and her W stun online — her burst combo outpaces your Ki Barrier shield if she catches you out of position before you can land E-taunt.
edits.after: All three Broken Wings dashes and Ki Burst are online — that burst outpaces Ki Barrier if she catches you out of position before you can land the E-taunt.

edits.before: Riven's first Ironspike Whip or Black Cleaver spike is her strongest solo-kill window; she can chain Q-W-Q into your Ki Barrier faster than it regenerates.
edits.after: Riven's first Ironspike Whip or Black Cleaver is her strongest solo-kill window; Broken Wings into Ki Burst breaks Ki Barrier faster than it regenerates.

notes: Level chart was wrong on six of seven rows in both layers simultaneously — because the two layers agreed with each other, the two-layer check would never have caught it; only the packet and the why text expose it. Corrected to match the packet and the already-audited mirror. Ability names: the page only ever said 'Q dashes' and 'W stun'; Broken Wings is now named in three places. Not written because the kit text does not settle it: whether Spirit's Refuge blocks Wind Slash (Riven's R is flagged projectile, but Riot's Spirit's Refuge text says it blocks attacks, and Wind Slash is an ability) — recorded as unverified. Note also that the full layer refers to Riven as 'his/him' in tradeGood, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and report[12] — a champion-level cosmetic pass, not fixed here.
